script.title: THE NOISE COMPLAINT
script.story_hook: Six weeks of late parties. Today we file a complaint.
script.intro_zh: 連續六週的深夜派對，今天正式投訴。
script.welcome_en: Today we visit the building manager about noise. Listen close!
script.welcome_zh: 今天我們去管理室投訴噪音。仔細聽！
script.outro: That's a calm complaint from start to finish. Nice work!
script.outro_zh: 這就是一場從頭到尾冷靜得體的投訴。做得好！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the complaint phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸投訴常用句。
script.char_a_description: a tired-looking Latino man in his thirties with short dark hair sticking up and two days of stubble, wearing an oversized gray hoodie, black joggers, and worn slip-on slippers
script.char_b_description: a poised woman in her late forties with a chin-length auburn bob and pearl earrings, wearing a navy cardigan over a white blouse, a gray pencil skirt, low pumps, and a name badge

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Are you the building manager?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɑr ju ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈmænɪdʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，您是樓管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am. Nora Fields. Can I help you?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈnɔrə fildz kæn aɪ hɛlp ju/
dialogue.zh: 是我，諾拉．菲爾茲。有可以幫忙的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm Sam Ortiz, apartment nine, first floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm sæm ɔrˈtsæz əˈpɑrtmənt naɪn fɚst flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我叫山姆．奧提茲，一樓九號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Sam. What's going on?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mi tʃu sæm wʌts ɡoʊɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，山姆。發生什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, honestly, the upstairs parties are brutal.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈɑnəstli ði ˈʌpˌstɛrz ˈpɑrtiz ɑr ˈbrutl̩/
dialogue.zh: 唉，說實話，樓上的派對實在太誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oof. Which unit is it, you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊf wɪtʃ ˈjunɪt ɪz ɪt ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嘖。你覺得是哪一戶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten, I believe. Every Friday, like clockwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn aɪ bɪˈliv ˈɛvri ˈfraɪdeɪ laɪk ˈklɑkˌwɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 應該是十號。每個星期五，準得像鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How late does the noise usually run?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ leɪt dʌz ðə nɔɪz ˈjuʒuəli rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 噪音通常鬧到多晚？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past two, sometimes three in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst tuː ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz θri ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 凌晨兩點過後，有時到三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's rough. How long has it been going?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts rʌf haʊ lɔŋ hæz ɪt bɪn ˈɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那真難熬。持續多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About six weeks. Maybe seven now.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt sɪks wiks ˈmeɪbi ˈsɛvən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 大約六週，現在可能七週了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six weeks... have you said anything to them?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wɪks hæv ju sɛd ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tə ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 六週了……你有去跟他們說過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I knocked once. Nobody even answered.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nɑkt wʌns ˈnoʊbəˌdi ˈivən ˈænsɚd/
dialogue.zh: 我去敲過一次門，根本沒人應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. You shouldn't have to confront strangers.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ju ˈʃʊdənt hæv tə kənˈfrʌnt ˈstreɪndʒɚz/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，你不該自己去面對陌生人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. So that's why I'm here today.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt soʊ ðæts waɪ aɪm hɪr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，所以我今天才來這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. Let's file a formal complaint.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl lɛts faɪl ə ˈfɔrməl kəmˈpleɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 做得好，我們來遞正式投訴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to write something?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə raɪt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要寫點什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just dates, times, and what you heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst deɪts taɪmz ænd wʌt ju hɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 只要日期、時間，還有你聽到的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I actually kept notes on my phone!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈæktʃuəli kɛpt noʊts ɑn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 其實我一直用手機在做筆記！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, future lawyer material. May I?
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ˈfjuːtʃɚ ˈlɔiyɚ məˈtɪriəəl meɪ aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，律師的料。可以給我看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here. Last Friday: bass, stomping, one-fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr læst ˈfraɪdeɪ beɪs ˈstɑmpɪŋ wʌn ˈfɪftiˈnɪn/
dialogue.zh: 給。上週五：重低音、跺腳聲，一點十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is gold. Detailed, dated, calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ɡoʊld dɪˈteɪld ˈdeɪtəd kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 這太珍貴了。詳細、有日期、又冷靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was calm. Mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz kɑm mostli/
dialogue.zh: 我有保持冷靜啦，大部分時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha. Now, do you know our quiet hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ naʊ du ju noʊ ɑr ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哈。那你知道安靜時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten p.m. to seven a.m., correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˌpiːˈɛm tə ˈsɛvən ˌeɪˈɛm kəˈrɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 晚上十點到早上七點，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct. After that, it's a lease violation.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt ˈæftɚ ðæts ə lis ˌvaɪəˈleɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 正確。過了時間就是違反租約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they actually lose their lease over noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ ˈæktʃuəli luz ðɛr lis ˈoʊvɚ nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噪音真的能讓他們丟掉租約？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only after warnings. Three, documented strikes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈæftɚ ˈwɔrnɪŋz θri ˈdɑkjəˌmɛntɪd straɪks/
dialogue.zh: 只在多次警告之後，需三次書面紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this is strike one, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs ɪz straɪk wʌn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以這是第一次紀錄，對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Officially, yes. I'll email a copy today.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈfɪʃəli jɛs aɪl ˈiməɪl ə ˈkɑpi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 正式來說是。我今天會寄副本給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. Will you tell them who complained?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du wɪl ju tɛl ðɛm hu kəmˈpleɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 請務必。你會說投訴人是誰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No names, standard policy. Don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ neɪmz ˈstændərd ˈpɑləsi doʊnt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 不透露姓名，這是原則，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. That was my biggest fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæt wʌz maɪ bɪɡɪst fɪr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這是我最大的顧慮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally get it. Retaliation's against the rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli ɡɛt ɪt rɪˌtæliˈeɪʃənz əˈɡɛnst ðə rulz/
dialogue.zh: 完全理解。報復是違規行為。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens next, realistically?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz nɛkst ˌriəˈlɪstɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 現實一點看，接下來會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I post a reminder Friday, then I monitor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ poʊst ə rɪˈmaɪndɚ ˈfraɪdeɪ ðɛn aɪ ˈmɑnɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我星期五貼公告，然後會持續留意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monitor? Like, you come listen at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑnɪtɚ laɪk ju kʌm ˈlɪsɪnz æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 留意？是說你晚上會來聽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes. Or I use the hallway recording app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɔr aɪ juz ðə ˈhɔˌleɪ rɪˈkɔrdɪŋ æp/
dialogue.zh: 有時會。或我用走廊的錄音紀錄系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the building records sound in halls?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈrɛkɚdz saʊnd ɪn hɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，大樓走廊還會錄音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Motion cams with audio, near the elevators only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊʃən kæmz wɪð ˈɔdioʊ nɪr ði ˈɛləˌveɪtɚz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 是有聲音的感應鏡頭，只裝在電梯附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. That might actually catch the guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌð ðæt maɪt ˈæktʃuəli kætʃ ðə ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 嘖，那說不定真能拍到客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often does. Noise fades once people know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən dʌz nɔɪz feɪdz wʌns ˈpipəl noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 常常有效。大家知道了，噪音就會退散。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I text you if it happens again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɛkst ju ɪf ɪt ˈhæpənz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 如果再發生，我能傳訊給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll put my number on the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔrs aɪl pʊt maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ðə fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我會把手機號寫在表單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Honestly, I slept four hours last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈɑnəstli aɪ slɛpt fɔr ˈaʊɚz læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，說真的，我昨晚只睡四小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight should already be quieter, fingers crossed.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ʃʊd ɔlˈrɛdi bi ˈkwaɪətɚ ˈfɪŋɡɚz krɔst/
dialogue.zh: 今晚就該安靜點了，祈禱吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll believe it when I hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bɪˈliv ɪt wɛn aɪ hɪr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等我親耳聽到才敢信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! Small favors: earplugs at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr smɔl ˈfeɪvɚz ˈɪrˌplʌɡz æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 應該的！小確幸：櫃台有耳塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the foam ones free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə foʊm wʌnz fri/
dialogue.zh: 泡棉那種是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free as air. Take the whole box.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri æz ɛr teɪk ðə hoʊl bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 免費，整盒都可以拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, Nora, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ ˈnɔrə ˈtruːli/
dialogue.zh: 你真是我的救星，諾拉，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job. Earplugs, then coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə dʒɑb ˈɪrˌplʌɡz ðɛn ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作。拿副耳塞，再來杯咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee sounds great. Black, no sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi saʊndz ɡreɪt blæk noʊ ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡太棒了，黑咖啡不加糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vending machine's by the mailroom, two fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛndɪŋ məˈʃiniz baɪ ðə ˈmeɪlˌrum tu ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 自動販賣機在信報房旁邊，兩塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My treat. Consider it a thank-you.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ trit kənˈsɪdɚ ɪt ə ˈθæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 我請客，就當是謝禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll allow it. Oh, one small ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl əˈlaʊ ɪt oʊ wʌn smɔl æsk/
dialogue.zh: 我就恭敬不如從命。喔，還有個小請求。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, what is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請說，是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give us two weeks before going higher-up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ʌs tu wiːks bɪˈfɔr ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈhaɪər ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 先給我們兩週，別急著往上級反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks? Deal. But I'm keeping notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks dil bʌt aɪm ˈkipɪŋ noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 兩週？成交。但筆記我會繼續記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Between us, those notes are excellent.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt bɪˈtwin ʌs ðoʊz noʊts ɑr ˈɛksələnt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。悄悄說，那些筆記非常漂亮。

script.youtube_description:
樓上半夜開派對，怎麽用英文正式投訴？
這一集是60句完整的投訴對話：記錄時間、安靜時段、警告規則、隱私保護，還能學到怎麼冷靜陳情。

你會學到：
・ describing noise problems politely（有禮地描述噪音）
・ quiet hours and lease violations（安靜時段與違規）
・ documenting dates and times（做書面紀錄）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，每晚都能多睡一小時！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
Your upstairs neighbors party until 3 a.m. Every. Friday. Here is the calm English to do something about it.
This episode is one full 60-line complaint: notes, quiet hours, warnings, privacy, and a friendly resolution.

You will hear:
・ polite but firm complaint language
・ building rules vocabulary
・ how documentation wins the day

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English that actually helps you sleep!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
樓上的低音又開到凌晨兩點了，怎麼辦？
用英文投訴，會不會顯得太兇？
這一集帶大家走進一樓管理室，睡不著的房客和管理員一起把噪音投訴寫得漂亮。

你會聽到：
📋「Just dates, times, and what you heard.」投訴要記什麼
🤫「Ten p.m. to seven a.m., correct?」安靜時段的問法
🚪「No names, standard policy.」隱私怎麼保障
🎧「Noise fades once people know.」管理員的心得句

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60句投訴對話，一句一句慢速重複，讓句子自然進到嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你的夜晚，從此只有安靜。
script.thumbnail_action: showing phone notes to the manager
